title: Talleres Tries to Press, But Suffers Defensive Lapses
subtitle: The Cordobés Club Seeks a Leading Role Under Sampaoli, But Faces Defensive Fragility
excerpt: Under Jorge Sampaoli's direction, Talleres has shown high pressing and mobility, but their defense has struggled, conceding 10 goals in five matches.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Under Jorge Sampaoli's direction, Talleres has shown high pressing and mobility, but their defense has struggled, conceding 10 goals in five matches. The club aims to overcome initial pressure and quickly attack the spaces left by the opponent.

High Press, But No Results

Coach Jorge Sampaoli attempts to make the Cordobés squad a protagonist team, with high pressing, significant mobility, and the intention to quickly recover the ball to attack. In their last match against Gimnasia de Mendoza, the team finished with 47% possession, 382 accurate passes, and five shots on target, but couldn't avoid a 1-3 defeat.

Fragile Defense

Tallarín's main weakness is its defensive fragility. The club has conceded 10 goals in its first five encounters, a number that highlights a problem the opponent can exploit. The high press and advanced positioning of the full-backs can leave areas exposed when the opposing team manages to bypass the first defensive line.

Psychological Challenges

The atmosphere at the club is tense, with four defeats in five matches and questions regarding Sampaoli's continuity. The coach and technical staff remained at the club throughout the week, preparing the team for a clash that could be decisive for the immediate future of the Cordobés squad.

What Central Should Do

For Jorge Almirón's team, the key is to overcome the initial press and quickly attack the spaces left by Talleres. If Central can build from the back cleanly, they might find a disorganized opponent in transitions. The other mission will be to prevent the Cordobés squad from dominating the pace of the game and quickly regaining confidence in front of their fans.

With information from RedBoing.
